text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Takarazuka Kinen. The 
decisive battle against Mejiro McQueen 
draws near.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus expresses her gratitude to 
her Trainer. Though it was a grueling 
rotation, it was truly enjoyable. She 
thanks them for letting her run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If they overcome this "Takarazuka Kinen," 
their proof will be complete. And it will 
forge open the possibilities for the 
future they seek.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the paddock, Mejiro McQueen greeted 
her. In response, Ikuno Dictus declared 
that she would throw everything she had 
into the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The curtain rises on the decisive stage, 
the Takarazuka Kinen!
